key_insight: VQE ansatz selection trades accuracy for circuit resources: ADAPT-VQE approaches UCCSD accuracy with lower overhead, while hardware-efficient ansätze reduce hardware costs but sacrifice accuracy.
engineering_relevance: Near-term molecular simulations require ansätze matched to molecular size, circuit-depth limits, and optimization capacity rather than a single universally optimal design.
method: Benchmark UCCSD, fermionic ADAPT-VQE, BasicPCA HEA, and Excitation Preserving HEA.
Compare performance across H₂, LiH, and N₂.
Evaluate circuit depth, parameter count, ground-state energy error, and NISQ feasibility.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that ADAPT-VQE becomes impractical around 10 electrons as circuit complexity grows, while HEA performance depends strongly on molecular size and Excitation Preserving HEA fails for N₂.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative error tables or device-noise conditions, limiting assessment of practical hardware advantage.
paper_title: A Unified Benchmarking Study of Variational Quantum Eigensolver Ansatz for Electronic Structure Problems
